name: NVDA/AMD Pairs Trading Strategy
description: Pairs trading strategy on NVDA vs AMD using SMA crossover on the price ratio. Computes the NVDA/AMD daily close ratio, then applies 20-day and 50-day SMAs. When the 20d SMA crosses above the 50d SMA, goes long NVDA / short AMD. When it crosses below, goes short NVDA / long AMD. Always in a position after the first crossover — no neutral zone. Each leg sized at 50% of account equity for dollar-neutral exposure.
source:
# NVDA/AMD Pairs Trading Strategy
# Signal: SMA crossover on the NVDA/AMD price ratio
# 20d SMA > 50d SMA → Long NVDA, Short AMD
# 20d SMA < 50d SMA → Short NVDA, Long AMD
# Always in a position (no flat zone), 50% allocation per leg

# --- Reference Data (consistent across both asset pages) ---
nvda_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="NVDA")()
amd_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="AMD")()

# --- Price Ratio ---
ratio = nvda_ref.c / amd_ref.c

# --- SMA Crossover on Ratio ---
fast_ratio_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)
slow_ratio_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# Crossover signals
ratio_cross_up = crossover(fast_ratio_sma, slow_ratio_sma)
ratio_cross_down = crossunder(fast_ratio_sma, slow_ratio_sma)

# Persistent state: ratio trending up or down
ratio_up = hold_until()(enter=ratio_cross_up, exit=ratio_cross_down)
ratio_down = hold_until()(enter=ratio_cross_down, exit=ratio_cross_up)

# --- Per-Asset Signal Routing ---
is_nvda = is_asset_ref(ticker="NVDA")()
is_amd = is_asset_ref(ticker="AMD")()

# NVDA: long when ratio trending up, short when ratio trending down
# AMD: short when ratio trending up, long when ratio trending down
long_entry = (is_nvda and ratio_up) or (is_amd and ratio_down)
short_entry = (is_nvda and ratio_down) or (is_amd and ratio_up)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# 50% of account equity per leg
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
